svg.text: Made in Cave Creek, AZ · @yoursocialhandle · www.websitehere.com
Grass-fed beef tallow, organic shea butter, organic jojoba
oil, organic frankincense oil, organic myrrh oil.
Warm a pea-sized amount between your fingers until it melts,
then press into damp skin. Best straight after a shower. The
scent settles and deepens over the first half hour rather than
announcing itself. Patch test on a small area before first use.
Whipped grass-fed tallow with organic shea butter and
organic jojoba. It melts on contact and leaves skin soft.
Tallow naturally carries vitamins A, D, E and K.
Store in a cool, dry place.
